jobs.title: Board Certified Behavior Analyst
jobs.description:

Illuminating Steps LLC is looking for a passionate and dedicated Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) to join our growing team in Roosevelt, NY. This is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the lives of individuals and families by delivering high-quality ABA services in a supportive, mission-driven environment.

**Responsibilities:**

* School-based
* Conduct comprehensive behavioral assessments, including FBAs and skills assessments, for clients
* Develop, implement, and monitor individualized ABA treatment plans and behavior intervention plans (BIPs)
* Provide direct supervision and training to Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs) and paraprofessionals
* Collect, analyze, and interpret behavioral data to drive clinical decision-making
* Collaborate with families, caregivers, and multidisciplinary teams to ensure consistency of care
* Maintain accurate clinical documentation in compliance with funding and regulatory requirements
* Participate in team meetings, case reviews, and ongoing professional development activities

**Requirements:**

* Active Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) certification in good standing
* Master's degree in Applied Behavior Analysis, Psychology, Special Education, or related field
* Experience working with individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and related developmental disabilities for 2+ years
* Proficiency in conducting FBAs, VB-MAPP, ABLLS-R, or similar assessments
* Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills for supervising RBTs and staff

**About Us:**

Illuminating Steps LLC is a dedicated behavioral health organization based in Roosevelt, NY, committed to empowering individuals with autism and developmental disabilities to reach their fullest potential. Our clients trust us for our compassionate, evidence-based approach to care, and our team members thrive in a culture that values professional growth, collaboration, and making a real difference every day.

jobs.title: Senior Process Safety Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Stratas Foods LLC is the leading supplier of fats and oils to the Foodservice, Food Ingredients and Retail Private Label markets in North America and is a producer of quality bulk and packaged dressings, mayonnaise and sauces. Stratas Foods was formed in October 2008 as a 50/50 joint venture between ACH Food Companies (ACH) and Archer Daniels Midland (ADM)

Manufacturing facilities are located in Dallas and Houston, TX; Decatur and Quincy, IL; Englewood, NJ; Hillside, NJ; Fresno, CA; Nashville, TN; and Valdosta, GA. Corporate offices are located in Memphis, TN. We are committed to maintaining a workplace that utilizes ideas, skills and talents of all of our employees. We strive to make Stratas Foods a great place to work and are building a team capable of meeting our business goals.

 **Job Description**

Develop, implement, manage, and continuously improve Stratas Foods' total process safety Management Program for processes and equipment presenting significant chemical, pressure, thermal, mechanical, fire, explosion, or stored-energy hazards. Program scope includes PSM/RMP-covered processes as well as other total process safety critical systems, including ammonia and CO2 refrigeration systems, boilers, compressed air systems, nitrogen generation and distribution systems, caustic and other hazardous chemical processes, combustible dust hazards, steam and condensate systems, hot liquids, cooking oil systems, and other applicable process hazards. Establish risk-based corporate standards, procedures, and minimum requirements to prevent significant releases, fires, explosions, equipment failures, and other total process safety incidents. This position will report to the Environmental Manager.

The Sr. Process Safety Management Analyst position requires up to 25% travel (or one week a month) to the various facilities of responsibility. This position can be based in Decatur, IL or Memphis, TN.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* **PSM Program Development:** Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve Stratas Foods' total process safety management systems covering regulated and non-regulated processes presenting significant chemical, pressure, thermal, fire, explosion, mechanical, or stored-energy hazards. Develop and monitor leading and lagging total process safety performance indicators to evaluate program effectiveness, identify systemic trends, prioritize risk reduction opportunities, and communicate total process safety performance to facility and executive leadership.
* **Compliance Metrics:** Determine regulatory applicability and oversee compliance with applicable total process safety requirements, including OSHA PSM, EPA RMP, and other federal, state, local, and applicable code requirements. Serve as a company total process safety representative during applicable regulatory interactions.
* **Process Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment and Total Process Safety:** Develop and oversee risk-based processes for identifying, evaluating, prioritizing, and controlling process hazards, including PHA and other appropriate hazard-assessment methodologies. Establish requirements for maintaining accurate total process safety and technical information for total process safety critical equipment and systems. Partner with Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Refrigeration contractors, EHS, and facility leadership to identify and evaluate total process safety impacts associated with new or modified equipment, processes, chemicals, technology, procedures, and operating conditions. Lead the implementation and integration of new or revised total process safety programs, corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and risk-control initiatives across applicable facilities.
* **Risk Assessment and Evaluation**: Where applicable provide total process safety oversight for chemical, thermal, fire, and explosion hazards, including caustic and other hazardous chemicals, hot cooking oils and process liquids, steam and condensate systems, and combustible dust where applicable. Evaluate process hazards and support the development and implementation of appropriate engineering, administration, inspection, maintenance, and operational controls based on risk.
* **Pressure Vessel Inspections and Asset Integrity:** Work with Maintenance and Engineering to coordinate regularly recurring pressure vessel inspections and develop/oversee corporate mechanical integrity requirements for total process safety-critical equipment and systems. Ensure Recognized and Generally Accepted Good Engineering Practices (RAGAGEP), applicable codes, standards, manufacturer recommendations are implemented and followed.
* **Critical Safety Device Management:** Develop, implement, and maintain Stratas Foods' Critical Safety Device Program, including the identification and documentation of applicable critical safety devices. Partner with Maintenance and other applicable functions to establish requirements for inspection, testing, impairment management, deficiency resolution, and verification of critical engineered safeguards.
* **Emergency Preparedness and Response:** Provide oversight and technical guidance for emergency action and response planning involving applicable total process safety hazards, including regulated and non-regulated processes. Coordinate with facility leadership, EHS, emergency responders, and applicable local agencies to ensure emergency plans, notification systems, drills/exercises, equipment, and response capabilities remain appropriate for facility hazards.
* **Regulatory Applicability / RMP Submittals:** Evaluate facilities and process changes for applicability under OSHA PSM, EPA RMP, and other applicable total process safety requirements. Coordinate preparation, certification, updates, and submission of required Risk Management Plans and associated regulatory documentation.

jobs.title: Senior RCM Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview:

*Essen Health Care is the largest privately held, multispecialty medical group in New York, providing high-quality, compassionate care to some of the state’s most vulnerable and underserved residents.*

*Founded in 1999, we’ve grown from a single primary care office into a network of 50+ locations offering urgent care, primary care and specialty services, from women’s health to endocrinology and psychiatry. We also provide nursing home support, care management, and in-home care through our Essen House Calls program. Guided by a Population Health model, our team of 500+ providers deliver care in-person, at home, or via telehealth, ensuring patients get the support they need when and where they need it.*

*We’re looking for talented, motivated individuals to join our growing team. Whether you’re a medical provider, administrator, or operations professional, there’s a career here for you. Join us in making a real difference in the health of our community.*

Job Summary:

The Sr. RCM Analyst is responsible for designing, implementing and supporting business and administrative analytics within revenue cycle functional areas; developing dashboards and reports with key performance indicators, metrics, data points and formulas. The Business Analyst will work across multiple teams to identify areas of opportunity to improve RCM processes, develop standard workflows and document and/or revise RCM policies and procedures as appropriate.

Responsibilities:

* Analyze and assess Revenue Cycle reports, workflows, and processes
* Assess the business use and functions of Revenue Cycle application systems providing recommendations for optimization as appropriate
* Revenue Cycle related problems and provide recommendations for resolution
* Conduct Revenue Cycle analysis by running, reviewing, interpreting and validation reports
* Performs quality assurance audits
* Other duties as assigned
* Acts as a subject matter expert and advocate for the EMR application supported, requiring depth and breadth in their knowledge of the business, technologies, and integration with other clinical applications
* Monitoring and managing the project resources, scope and timeline
* Provides technical oversight and direction to eClinicalworks onshore/offshore EMR team
* Identify and access user needs to provide effective solution and support in a proactive manner that meet the business requirements
* Effectively communicates to 3rd party vendors on the business requirements and drives the solution to closure
* Provides technical support to business users and engages vendor as appropriate to effectively address the issues in a timely manner
* Ensures clinical workflows are properly developed, tested, and implemented in production to drive business outcomes
* Develop and document clinical workflows, configure features and functions in EMR and help support training the business capabilities to end users
* Effectively manages and support the systems integration (Lab, Imaging etc.) with EMR
* Participates and leads in the review and testing of major releases and upgrades, evaluating new functionality and master file changes for new features including training and support
* Serves as EMR steward and liaison between clinical users, technical teams and vendors to ensure that technical delivery aligns with strategic direction
* Leads monthly EMR meetings with clinical and operations team
* Lead change by influencing and educating business, IT and partners
* Assist users in developing best practices and optimization goals and ensure the system is providing the improved and desired level of patient care
* Provide end user Tier II Support
* Identify areas of improvements for existing systems and new opportunities that will drive value to the business and support the organizational goals in a broader sense.

Qualifications:

* Job requirements:

  + Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare, finance, computer science or related field required, Master s Degree preferred
  + Minimum 2+ years of experience in Revenue Cycle Management
  + Minimum 2-4 years of experience managing and support EMR
  + Two (2) years of experience working as a systems analyst with hands-on applications experience
  + Experience analyzing complex issues and/or requests to provide effective solutions with the ability to identify root cause, communicate options and propose solutions
  + Experience in developing and managing projects and workflow reengineering.
  + Strong ability to bridge the gap between multiple departments or levels of expertise to effectively communicate outcomes and solutions in a comprehensive and meaningful manner
  + Strong ability to work cross functionally between department to build relationships and analyze reports or data and presenting it in a way that is comprehensive to all relevant parties

Equal Opportunity Employer:

***Essen Health care is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we seek candidates who desire to work in and serve an ethnically diverse population.***

jobs.title: Analyst – Sponsor and Franchise Portfolio Man
jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

This individual will primarily be responsible for the day-to-day management of the Franchise Finance portfolio of Mitsubishi HC Capital America, Inc. (MHCA), but will also assist with similar portfolio management activities on the Sponsor Finance portfolio. Daily activities will be centered on the monitoring and management of the portfolio including the preparation of credit underwriting memos in support of amendments and modifications of existing credit facilities. Key areas of focus will be the management of credit risk, the monitoring of compliance, preparation of internal reporting, and the maintenance and monitoring of borrower relationships. This position will collaborate closely with the underwriting and sales teams.

**Commitment to Internal Control:**

The incumbent must understand, abide, and uphold the system of internal controls related to the essential duties and responsibilities of the position.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Compile weekly and monthly portfolio reports for the Franchise Finance portfolio and for assigned transactions on the Sponsor Portfolio.
* Prepare trend cards as needed and aid in the preparation and presentation of the quarterly portfolio reviews on a quarterly basis or more frequently as needed. This includes financial covenant trend analysis, past financial performance analysis and performance to plan (vs. base case from underwriting) analysis.
* Update of financial projections and enterprise value analysis as needed.
* Proactively identify adverse client trends and take necessary steps toward positive resolution and minimize credit loss exposure.
* Determine appropriate risk rating for each borrower while ensuring timely rating changes as needed.
* Perform the necessary due diligence in the preparation of credit underwritings in support of amendments, modifications, and extensions for existing transactions.

* Make recommendation to the VP Senior Credit Officer, SVP - Chief Credit Officer – Specialty Finance, EVP – Chief Credit Officer, and other senior management regarding transactions for approval under local delegation, or for their recommendation for approval by International Credit Division of MHC/Tokyo. Presentation to local Credit Committee as required.

* Attend bank meetings in person or via teleconference as needed.
* Coordinate with agent banks to confirm covenant and financial reporting is in accordance with loan document requirements.
* Assist with the underwriting of new business as needed.
* Manage Salesforce records and information files.

**Management/Supervisory Responsibilities:**
============================================

* None.

**Responsibility and Decision-Making Authority:**
=================================================

* Credit assessment, structure, and transaction communication within company prepared guidelines.
* Control portfolio risk and mitigate loan loss to acceptable levels.

**Qualifications:**

*Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:*
===================================

* Basic experience with cash flow finance transactions (acquisition finance, LBOs), experience with Franchise Finance a plus.

* Basic understanding of structuring, underwriting, and documentation practices elated to senior secured cash flow loans.
* Basic knowledge of corporate finance principles, including financial statement analysis, projection analysis and financial cash flow modeling (three statement models).

* Familiarity with reporting and financial covenants for senior secured cash flow loans.
* Strong computer software skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Salesforce)
* Good interpersonal, organizational, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Team player with positive attitude who understands role and how it relates to overall company success factors and keeps commitment to others.

* Time Management: ability to organize and manage multiple priorities and complete on a timely and accurate basis.
* Have a clear understanding of MHCA’s credit policies and operational procedures.

**Competencies:**
=================

  

* + Thinking skills
  + Analytical ability

* Communications
  + Ability to transmit information
  + Ability to listen
* Interpersonal Relationships
  + Ability to work in a Team

* Personal Qualities
  + Action-oriented
  + Resilient
  + Adaptability
  + Self-starter

**Education and Experience:**
=============================

* BS in Accounting, Finance or Economics or equivalent experience.
* Formal credit training, with min. 1 year of experience in commercial lending, preferably in a portfolio management role.

**Licensing and Certification:**

jobs.title: Analyst (Bankruptcy)
jobs.description:
The Analyst serves as part of a professional team providing financial, economic, and investigative analysis across the full spectrum of bankruptcy cases. Depending on grade level, the Analyst performs increasingly complex financial reviews, audits, investigative work, trustee oversight, and case evaluations to support the USTP’s mission.

*Duties vary by grade level; higher levels reflect greater independence, complexity, and subject-matter expertise*

**Bankruptcy Analysis**

* Reviews petitions, schedules, disclosure materials, and financial records—onsite when necessary—to assess accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* Identifies deficiencies, fraud indicators, or potential criminal activity and recommends appropriate case actions.
* Prepares analytical summaries and exhibits; may provide testimony.
* At higher levels, evaluates complex financial structures, conducts debtor conferences, and provides expert analysis in major Chapter 11 cases.

**Financial Analysis**

* Evaluates financial feasibility and business viability by analyzing corporate structures, assets, liabilities, cash flow, management capability, and projections.
* Assesses compliance with financial reporting requirements and identifies financial risks.
* At senior levels, leads or participates in multi-agency audit teams and evaluates large or highly complex entities.

**Trustee Oversight**

* Conducts or supports reviews and audits of trustees to ensure compliance with Program policies, accounting standards, and statutory requirements.
* Evaluates case administration, banking practices, internal controls, and bond sufficiency.
* Reviews Independent Public Accountant audits, identifies issues, and recommends corrective actions.
* Analyses periodic financial reports and budgets in accordance with uniform standards.
* At senior levels, develops program-wide recommendations and provides expert guidance on complex oversight matters.

**Other Duties**

* Conducts research, prepares reports, and supports legal and investigative actions.
* Collaborates with attorneys, financial specialists, management officials, and external stakeholders
* Incorporates technologies and financial automation tools into daily work to maximize accuracy and efficiency

Pay: $125,431.00 - $192,694.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Analyst, FIU Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB), located in New York City, is seeking an FIU Coordinator to join our Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) in the Compliance department. CFSB offers a full range of banking services, including ACH settlement services, pre-paid card issuance, and retail banking. In addition to serving our general customer base, we also service various types of money service businesses and FinTech companies.

This individual will provide administrative and coordination support to the FIU. The FIU Coordinator will prepare and gather documents and information for Section 314(b) requests and responses, subpoenas, and other information requests; coordinate Requests for Information with internal and external stakeholders; maintain accurate records and tracking logs; monitor deadlines; and escalate delays, gaps, or other issues requiring attention. The role requires strong organization, attention to detail, communication, workload management, and the ability to work independently while following established procedures.

The role is fully remote in 24 select states or hybrid for those located in the NYC Metro area.

\*\*This position supports ongoing hiring needs and may remain posted until headcount is available. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and candidates may be considered for current or future openings.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate assigned FIU administrative requests and work items in accordance with established procedures, priorities, and deadlines.
* Prepare, gather, organize, and quality-check documents and information needed to support Section 314(b) requests and responses, subpoenas, and other FIU information requests.
* Coordinate Requests for Information with appropriate internal departments, program partners, financial institutions, and other stakeholders; communicate requirements and deadlines; and follow up on outstanding items.
* Maintain complete and accurate request files, correspondence, supporting documentation, status records, and tracking logs.
* Manage assigned workload, track due dates and dependencies, prioritize competing requests, and complete deliverables accurately and on time.
* Work independently within established procedures and promptly escalate missed deadlines, incomplete or conflicting information, unusual requests, or other issues requiring management attention.
* Provide timely status updates, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and help ensure requests move efficiently from intake through completion.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with appropriate care and in accordance with Bank requirements.
* Provide administrative support for FIU meetings, reporting, special projects, ad hoc tasks as needed, and other priorities, as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, competing priorities, and time-sensitive deadlines in a structured and reliable manner.
* Ability to work independently, follow established procedures, exercise appropriate judgment, and escalate questions or issues when needed.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office products, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint, with the ability to create, organize, track, and maintain business records and correspondence.
* Strong time-management, prioritization, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
* Clear and professional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to coordinate requests and communicate requirements, status, and follow-up needs effectively.
* Ability to collaborate effectively, handle confidential information with discretion, and recognize when matters should be escalated.

**Education, Training, and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Criminal Justice, Compliance, or a related field; or equivalent education and relevant work experience.
* Experience in an administrative, operations, coordination, records-management, legal-support, compliance-support, or similar role is preferred.
* Prior AML/BSA, financial crime, transaction monitoring, or investigative experience is not required; role-specific procedures and requirements will be provided through training.
* Experience using Microsoft Office products to organize information, maintain trackers, prepare documents, and manage business communications is preferred.
* Experience handling confidential or sensitive information and maintaining accurate records is preferred.
* Ability and willingness to learn FIU processes, Section 314(b) requests, subpoena-response procedures, Requests for Information, and related recordkeeping requirements.

jobs.title: Analyst, Financial Intelligence Unit
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB), located in New York City, is seeking an FIU Analyst to join our Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) in the Compliance department. CFSB offers a full range of banking services, including ACH settlement services, pre-paid card issuance, and retail banking. In addition to serving our general customer base, we also service various types of money service businesses and FinTech companies.

This individual will be responsible for performing financial intelligence reviews involving potentially unusual or suspicious activity across the Bank’s products, customers, and partner programs. Under established procedures and appropriate guidance, the FIU Analyst will review alerts and referrals, analyze transactional activity and customer information, conduct relevant internal and external research, document findings, recommend appropriate dispositions, and escalate matters requiring further investigation or consideration. The FIU Analyst will contribute to timely, accurate, and consistent FIU reviews and documentation.

\*\*The role is fully remote in 24 select states or hybrid for those located in the NYC Metro area.

\*\*This position supports ongoing hiring needs and may remain posted on a continuous basis. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and candidates may be considered for current or future openings.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Review assigned transaction monitoring alerts, internal or external referrals, and other FIU work items in accordance with established procedures and timelines.
* Review transactional activity, customer profiles, account history, prior investigations and filings, and relevant internal and external research to identify potential financial crime risk indicators and unusual patterns.
* Prepare clear, complete, and accurate review documentation and case narratives that summarize activity reviewed, research performed, findings, and rationale.
* Recommend alert or case dispositions based on available information and established guidance and promptly escalate potential suspicious activity or other matters requiring additional review.
* Manage assigned work items and priorities to meet review deadlines and quality expectations.
* Collaborate with FIU colleagues and seek guidance from experienced investigators or FIU leadership when questions or complex matters arise.
* Identify and communicate observed trends, recurring issues, and potential process concerns to FIU management.
* Develop knowledge of AML/BSA regulatory requirements, financial crime risks, enforcement trends, and relevant typologies through training and practical experience.
* Assist with special projects and other FIU priorities, as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Ability and willingness to learn and apply AML/BSA requirements, financial crime concepts, suspicious activity monitoring processes, and SAR requirements through training and practical experience.
* Ability to review transactional and customer information, recognize relevant risk indicators or unusual patterns, and document findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to manage a deadline-driven workload while following established procedures.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) or related software; familiarity with transaction monitoring or case management systems is a plus.
* Analytical, organizational, research, and problem-solving skills.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to summarize research and findings in a concise, organized manner.
* Ability to follow procedures, work collaboratively, manage assigned tasks, and seek guidance when needed.

**Education, Training, and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Criminal Justice, Risk Management, Compliance, or a related field; or equivalent education and work experience.
* Entry-level position; prior professional experience in financial crimes compliance or investigations is not required. Relevant internship, coursework, or experience in banking, payments, fraud, compliance, investigations, data analysis, or research is preferred.
* No prior AML/BSA, financial crime, transaction monitoring, or investigative experience is required; role-specific knowledge will be provided through training.
* Interest in learning about banking operations, payment services, fintech partnerships, and the broader financial services ecosystem.
* Interest in pursuing a relevant professional certification, such as CAMS or CFE, is a plus but not required.
* Interest in developing knowledge of financial services industry risks, fraud and money laundering typologies, applicable regulations, fintech partnerships, and payment systems.

**About Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB)**

Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB) is a federally chartered bank founded in 2001 and headquartered in New York City. CFSB has focused on providing superior service and added value to clients though a solid understanding of relationship banking. We offer a full range of services, including loans, bill payments, card services, internet banking, and merchant processing.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military and/or veteran status, or any other Federal or State legally-protected classes.

That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

**About the Role**

We protect some of the world's largest, most complex hybrid identity environments, and that mission depends on earning and keeping our customers' trust. Our GRC team runs the certification and audit programs that let security-conscious enterprises, regulated industries, and government customers adopt our cloud products with confidence.

As our Cybersecurity GRC Analyst, you'll support the team across governance, risk, compliance, and customer trust work, and you'll own our annual security awareness training campaign. This is a hands-on, learning-focused role: you'll start with well-defined tasks and take on more complex work as you learn our programs.

We are a small team, so you'll get exposure to every part of GRC. In your first year, you'll gather audit evidence for SOC 2 and ISO 27001, answer customer security questionnaires, coordinate policy updates, and support our vendor risk and FedRAMP work. Experienced teammates review your work and are there to help when something is new or complex. You'll also have AI and GRC tooling, including Vanta, to help you work efficiently.

You'll succeed by being organized, responsive, and easy to work with, making it simpler for control owners to provide what audits and customers need.

**+++No sponsorship will be provided for this role. Candidate must be eligible to work in the country in which you apply+++**

**What You Will Do**

**Security Awareness Training**

* Follow up on overdue security training, then lead the annual Security and Compliance Training campaign: work with People Operations and Legal on the curriculum, set up enrollments in the training platform, track completion weekly, and escalate overdue training.
* Handle training exceptions, keep training records ready as audit evidence, and gather feedback to improve next year's campaign.

**Why Epicured?**

Epicured is on a mission to combat and prevent chronic disease, translating scientific research into high-quality food products for patients nationwide. Our evidence-based approach brings the best of the clinical and culinary worlds together to help people eat better, feel better, and live better one meal at a time.

**About Epicured**

Epicured helps prevent and manage chronic disease through medically tailored nutrition, combining clinical research with culinary expertise to improve health outcomes nationwide. Join a mission-driven team working at the intersection of food, healthcare, and technology.

By joining our team, you’ll contribute to meaningful initiatives at the intersection of food, healthcare, and technology — helping to improve access, reduce complexity, and directly impact the lives of people managing chronic health conditions.

**Position Overview**

Epicured is seeking a Culinary & Recipe Data Analyst to serve as a system manager and technical backbone for our recipe database in Galley. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end input, audit, and management of recipe data across all of our business lines.

Working directly with our Culinary Product Manager, you will follow established SOPs to ensure that every dish—from raw ingredient sourcing and vendor mapping to nutrition profiles and clinical allergen tags—is accurately modeled in Galley.

This is a critical role that directly unblocks our culinary backlog and optimizes product development. You will protect the integrity of our database architecture, support our cross-functional workflows, and have room to grow into broader product and data analysis responsibilities within the department.

**Responsibilities**

* Recipe Data Management - input, standardize, and maintain detailed recipe specifications across all business lines within the Galley platform according to company SOPs.
* Ingredient & Vendor Architecture - onboard and manage ingredients, map vendor supply data, and link accurate nutritional definitions and unit conversions.
* Attribute & Tagging Governance - apply and audit clinical, dietary, and operational attributes (e.g., Low FODMAP, Diabetes-Friendly, Cardiovascular, Active, Inactive) at both the sub-recipe and completed dish level to protect system integrity.
* Cross-Functional Data Quality - partner with culinary, clinical, and operation teams to audit existing recipes, correct discrepancies, and perform regular quality assurance checks on menu data.
* Process & System Support - identify operational bottlenecks in recipe data entry, assist in refining SOPs, and ensure data consistency to support downstream menu planning and rotation, nutrition review, and labeling outputs.

**Qualifications**

* Industry Experience: 2-3 years of food industry experience; whether through commercial kitchen/culinary experience, a background in food regulation, or work as a Registered Dietitian.
* Education: a degree in Food Science (preferred)
* Systems / Data Literacy: Proficiency in database entry or food management platforms (Galley experience is a huge plus, but other system experience is welcome).
* Eager to learn, adapt, and scale responsibilities within culinary operations / product development within the organization.
* Technical / Analytical Skills: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets for data manipulation, cross-referencing, and basic analysis.

MTA Bridges and Tunnels operates the largest bridge and tunnel network in New York City, managing nine crossings that include seven bridges and two tunnels. Serving more than 336 million vehicle crossings each year, this network connects communities across the five boroughs and supports regional mobility. In addition, MTA Bridges and Tunnels oversees the Congestion Relief Zone, working to ensure safe, efficient travel and a more sustainable urban environment. MTA strives to provide a safe and reliable commute, excellent customer service, and rewarding opportunities.

This position is eligible for telework which is currently one day per week. New hires are eligible to apply 30 days after their effective date of hire.

The Senior Data Analyst, Revenue Strategy will support MTA Bridges & Tunnels (B&T) in identifying, evaluating, and advancing opportunities to protect, recover, and optimize toll revenue. The position will support Revenue Strategy function through data analysis, performance measurement, reporting, and the development of actionable insights that inform revenue-related initiatives and management decision-making. The Senior Data Analyst will facilitate the development and maintenance of analytical tools, dashboards, and reporting capabilities while working under the direction of the Vice President, Revenue Strategy and in close collaboration with teams across B&T and the broader MTA. The Senior Data Analyst will analyze transactional, customer, payment, accounts receivable, operational, and other relevant data to identify trends, explain variances, evaluate revenue performance, and quantify potential revenue opportunities and risks. The position will also support the development of key performance indicators and analytical frameworks to measure the effectiveness of revenue protection and recovery initiatives. This position is vital to supporting B&T's revenue strategy and requires strong analytical skills, independent judgment, attention to data quality, and the ability to translate complex information into clear findings and recommendations.

The incumbent will work closely with senior staff and cross-functional partners to:

* Conduct complex data cleaning, aggregation, reconciliation, validation, and analysis to distill large and diverse datasets into meaningful metrics, trends, and actionable insights.

* Analyze toll revenue performance and customer payment behavior to identify trends, anomalies, revenue leakage, emerging risks, and opportunities for revenue protection and recovery.

* Analyze accounts receivable, aging, collections, payment activity, and other relevant measures to support an understanding of outstanding balances and revenue recovery performance.

* Develop and maintain key performance indicators, dashboards, analytical tools, and recurring reporting that provide management with visibility into revenue performance and the effectiveness of Revenue Strategy initiatives.

* Evaluate revenue recovery and other strategic initiatives by establishing appropriate baselines, analyzing customer or transaction populations, tracking outcomes, and quantifying financial impact where data permits.

* Conduct revenue recovery, customer payment, segmentation, propensity-to-pay, predictive, trend, variance, root-cause, and scenario analyses to evaluate performance, identify high-priority recovery opportunities, and support data-driven recommendations.

* Perform scenario analysis and develop data-driven business cases to help prioritize revenue opportunities, evaluate potential interventions, and support recommendations to senior management.

* Collaborate with B&T and MTA departments, including Tolling, Finance and Accounting, Revenue Recovery, Operations, Information Technology, Data and Analytics, Legal, and other stakeholders, to obtain and interpret data and address complex revenue-related analytical questions.

* Collaborate with data owners and subject matter experts to ensure timely access to required data and develop a thorough understanding of source datasets, business rules, data quality, and limitations.

* Develop and enhance interactive data visualizations and analytical tools that enable technical and non-technical audiences, including senior management, to understand revenue performance, trends, risks, and potential actions.

* Document analytical methodologies, business rules, data sources, assumptions and processes, and perform appropriate data-quality and validation checks to ensure analytical results are accurate and reproducible.

* Identify, integrate, and analyze new or emerging datasets to address evolving revenue, payment, customer behavior, operational, and policy questions on an as-needed basis.

* Continually identify opportunities to improve Revenue Strategy's analytical and reporting capabilities, including automating recurring analyses, reducing manual processes, improving data accessibility and reliability, and developing tools that allow the organization to identify and respond to revenue issues more quickly.

jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Invesco**
=================

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

**What’s in it for you?**
=========================

Our people are at the very core of our success. Invesco employees get more out of life through our comprehensive compensation and benefit offerings including:

* Flexible paid time off
* Hybrid work schedule
* 401(K) matching of 100% up to the first 6% with a discretionary supplemental contribution
* Health & wellbeing benefits
* Parental Leave benefits
* Employee stock purchase plan

**Job Description**
===================

**Quantitative Analyst, Municipal Fixed Income**

**Your Team**

The Quantitative Analyst will be part of the broader quantitative team supporting Invesco Fixed Income. The team develops market research, data, models, and analytical tools that strengthen investment decision-making, portfolio construction, and risk management. This role will focus on municipal strategies and work closely with portfolio managers and credit researchers on market, portfolio, and security-level questions. The analyst will also partner with quantitative, technology, and data colleagues to build reliable data and reusable analytical capabilities.

**Your Role**

As a Quantitative Analyst, you will combine municipal market knowledge, quantitative analysis, and practical implementation to support portfolio managers and credit researchers. You will identify and evaluate investment questions involving relative value, portfolio positioning, risk, performance, and market structure and build the tools needed to test and apply your ideas. You will have end-to-end responsibility for the municipal data supporting this work, from understanding source systems and resolving discrepancies to producing controlled analytical datasets. The role requires curiosity about markets and an interest in the daily work of turning data and investment ideas into reliable, useful analytics.

**You Will Be Responsible For:**

* Generating and evaluating quantitative investment ideas related to municipal relative value, portfolio positioning, performance drivers, and market opportunities.
* Measuring portfolio exposures on an absolute and benchmark-relative basis, including interest-rate, yield-curve, spread, credit, liquidity, and optionality risks.
* Developing scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess how market changes could affect performance, volatility, distributions, and portfolio positioning.
* Investigating differences between expected and realized performance, distinguishing market and economic drivers from data or model issues, and communicating findings to portfolio managers and credit researchers.
* Evaluating leverage and funding risks, including tender option bond and variable-rate municipal term preferred exposures and their implications for total return, liquidity, and distributions.
* Managing municipal data end to end, including acquisition, definitions, transformations, timing, lineage, quality controls, reconciliation, and availability across systems such as Perform and Aladdin.
* Building and maintaining analytical tools and automated workflows for holdings, transactions, pricing, benchmarks, risk, and performance while reducing routine manual processing.
* Partnering with investment, quantitative, technology, and data colleagues to test new ideas, implement useful analytics, and contribute reusable data, methods, and code to the broader platform.

**The Experience You Bring:**

* Experience applying quantitative analysis to fixed-income markets, relative value, portfolio risk, performance attribution, or portfolio construction.
* Knowledge of municipal securities, market conventions, portfolio structures, benchmarks, and sources of risk, or relevant fixed-income experience and a demonstrated ability to develop new market expertise.
* Demonstrated ability to formulate investment or analytical questions and build practical tools, models, or applications to evaluate them.
* Strong hands-on Python and SQL skills, including experience working with complex datasets and automating analytical workflows.
* Experience investigating data from multiple systems, reconciling inconsistencies, establishing data-quality controls, and developing reliable analytical datasets.
* Familiarity with modern development practices and platforms such as Git or GitHub, cloud infrastructure, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable technologies.
* Experience using AI-assisted research or development tools to explore ideas, develop code, test analytical approaches, or improve productivity.
* Strong judgment and communication skills, including the ability to connect technical analysis to market developments, portfolio exposures, and practical investment decisions.

The salary range for this position in New York City is 145,000 - 158,000 USD/year. The total compensation offered for this position includes salary and incentive pay and will vary based on skills, experience and location

**Full Time / Part Time**
=========================

Full time

**Worker Type**
===============

Employee

**Job Exempt (Yes / No)**
=========================

Yes

**Workplace Model**
===================

Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.

**Job Description**
-------------------

About the Agency:
  
  
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.
  
  
As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.
  
  
Your Team:
  
  
The Office of Policy and Strategy (OPS) leverage its expertise to guide and support HPD and its many Offices in their efforts to deepen their impact, optimize their efficiency, and become more data-driven, climate-adaptive, and mission-focused. OPS collaborates with staff and senior leadership from across the Agency, as well as with representatives from other Agencies. OPS carries out its work through delivery of rigorous data, policy, and financial/credit analysis; technical and statistical research; and techniques in program visioning and design. OPS is comprised of six areas: Credit & Valuation, Housing Equity, Housing Policy, Research & Evaluation, Strategic Operations and Analytics, and Sustainability.
  
  
The Division of Housing Equity (DHE) oversees the agency’s fair housing initiatives and obligations. Through its development of the City’s comprehensive five-year fair housing plan and regular related reports, the Division applies a lens of access and fairness to the City's public investments. DHE is responsible for digital equity, disability, sustainability, and fair housing policies.
  
  
The Fair Housing Policy & Investments (FHPI) team works at the forefront of some of the most challenging housing and affordable housing policy issues to face New York City. Alongside other members of the Division of Housing Equity and colleagues across the agency, the team will focus on confronting discrimination, segregation, and disparities in access to opportunity and on promoting programs and policies that affirmatively further fair housing. Recent FHPI projects include Where We Live 2025, the City’s comprehensive fair housing plan; the inaugural Fair Housing Growth Strategy; a citywide testing program to root out housing discrimination; and coordinating a response to federal changes to fair housing law.
  
  
Your Role:
  
  
Your role will be to support the FHPI team in carrying out HPD’s and the NYC’s fair housing policy obligations via administrative and research tasks under the direction of the Director of FHPI.
  
  
On a daily basis, you will serve as a central coordinator and researcher, contributing to the translation of high-level policy into municipal action. Your day-to-day will range from deep-dive policy research and data compilation to inter- and cross-agency communication and vendor management. You will manage compliance timelines, track vendor and city-wide progress for FHPI initiatives, and create and compile comprehensive reports.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to work with team members at all levels, as well as engage with the agency's senior leadership. You will work very closely with the Director of FHPI on a daily basis in a rigorous, growth-oriented, and supportive environment.
  
  
Your Responsibilities:
  
  
As the Fair Housing Policy Analyst for the Division of Housing Equity, you will:
  

* Work with teams across the agency and agencies across the city to implement the City’s fair housing commitments as laid out in Where We Live NYC, as well as additional initiatives and policies to affirmatively further fair housing;
* Undertake policy analysis to advance new and existing projects, using data rigorously to shape compelling narratives;
* Report on the City’s progress in implementing the Where We Live NYC commitments;
* Facilitate communication with HPD source of income (SOI) testing vendors to collect testing materials; reply to inquiries and concerns pertaining to reporting requirements and contractual obligations;
* Conduct research and provide guidance on program and policy design to ensure current and proposed policies and programs affirmatively further fair housing; and
* Collaborate closely with the other OPS and agency teams and actively support learning and development across teams.

  
Preferred skills
  
  
The ideal candidate will have:
  

* Professional writing, editing, and reporting experience (outside of school or an academic program);
* Fair housing experience (FHIP, FHAP, etc.) with a focus in enforcement, fair housing counseling (including reviewing/ assisting with complaints), and/or housing law expertise;
* Policy research and analysis: at least 2-3 years of professional experience researching, reviewing, analyzing, and citing peer-reviewed articles, government publications, and scholarly references to develop fair housing strategies and policy recommendations for HPD and NYC government agency publications;
* Understanding of and interest in housing policy and fair housing law;
* Creativity, self-awareness, emotional intelligence and grit;
* Self-starter and takes initiative with strong follow-through;
* Strong written and verbal communication skills;
* Strong attention to detail, project management and organization skills;
* Responsiveness and adaptability to meet changing or tight deadlines;
* Passion for public service;

AI Operations | Managed AI Services | Full-Time, Exempt
  
ECI is seeking an AI Operations Analyst to serve as the operational front door for AI across its client base. This role helps clients adopt, operate, govern, and expand their use of approved enterprise AI platforms while ensuring each request is connected to the right technical guidance, governance path, and service engagement.
  
  
About ECI
  
ECI is building a dedicated AI Operations capability to help regulated organizations operate AI successfully and responsibly at scale. The AI Operations Analyst will work alongside engineers, governance specialists, adoption consultants, business development, and client-facing teams while helping shape ECI's managed AI operations discipline.
  
Position Summary
  
The AI Operations Analyst owns AI-related requests from intake through outcome confirmation, coordinating work across internal teams and maintaining clear client communication. The role combines technical support, client advisory, use-case discovery, governance awareness, and service coordination. Success requires understanding the business need behind each request, translating technical concepts into practical guidance, and engaging the appropriate specialists when broader value or deeper expertise is required.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Serve as the primary intake point for AI-related incidents, requests, advisory questions, changes, and operational needs, maintaining ownership through confirmed resolution or outcome.
* Classify, prioritize, document, and coordinate work through established service-management processes and provide proactive communication to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Provide operational support for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Anthropic Claude Enterprise, OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot Studio, approved agents and connectors, and future approved AI platforms.
* Support licensing, entitlements, user access, group membership, troubleshooting, configuration validation, feature guidance, prompt assistance, and agent triage.
* Determine when a request can be resolved through a standard procedure and when AI Engineering, Security Operations, Infrastructure, AI Deployment, AI Adoption, AI Governance, or another specialist team should be engaged.
* Engage clients to understand the business objective behind technical requests and connect needs to relevant AI use cases, productivity goals, adoption requirements, and operational outcomes.
* Provide guidance on documented platform capabilities, limitations, and best practices, and participate in discovery discussions when technical context is needed.
* Recognize opportunities for AI Adoption, AI Governance, AI Engineering, AI Deployment, managed AI services, or related project work, and introduce the appropriate ECI leader or delivery specialist.
* Identify data protection, responsible AI, security, compliance, shadow AI, prompt-injection, and data-exposure concerns and route them through the correct escalation process.
* Maintain knowledge articles, runbooks, and standard operating procedures; track recurring support patterns and release impacts; and recommend automation, self-service, and service improvements.

Required Qualifications
  

* Three to seven years of experience in technical account management, customer success engineering, managed services operations, solutions engineering, Microsoft 365 administration, IT service delivery, SaaS support, or enterprise technical support.
* Demonstrated success in a client-facing technical role and experience using an IT service-management platform such as ServiceNow.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Copilot, Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms, SaaS administration, licensing, single sign-on, SCIM, conditional access, and ITIL service-management concepts.
* Foundational understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, data protection, security, and operational risk.
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business language, uncover requirements through discovery conversations, and coordinate effectively across technical and client-facing teams.
* Excellent written communication, documentation, analytical, escalation-management, and knowledge-authoring skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Purview, Defender for Cloud Apps, or Microsoft Power Platform.

* Experience supporting financial services or another regulated industry.

ECI’s culture is all about connection - connection with our clients, our technology and most importantly with each other. In addition to working with an amazing team around the world, ECI also offers a competitive compensation package and the base salary for this role is $125,000 plus flexible PTO, health benefit eligibility the first of the month, life insurance, pet insurance, 401K and so much more! Love Your Job, Share Your Technology Passion, Create Your Future Here!
  
ECI is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration consistent with applicable law.

jobs.title: Energy Analytics, TPM, Global Energy, Sustainability and Automation
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Energy Analytics, Technical Program Manager (TPM) will scale power monitoring, insight generation, and energy and carbon reduction initiatives across Amazon's North America fulfillment operations. In this hands-on technical role, you will deploy and generate analysis from power metering infrastructure and implement load flexibility and energy optimization roadmaps that deliver measurable cost savings and carbon reductions. This work directly supports Amazon's demand-side power requirements and Climate Pledge commitments.  
  
You will operate as an individual contributor, owning the delivery of defined and ambiguous work-streams while partnering with engineering, controls, data, operations and deployment teams to implement changes. You will influence cross-functional partners without authority, primarily at the team and management level, using data to drive decisions. You will integrate and analyze power metering information, providing load forecasts and generating cost and energy savings opportunities. Utility rate structures, time of day, demand ratchets and power factor penalties will influence your strategies. Technical assets influenced can include material handling, robotics, powered industrial trucks, lighting, heating ventilation and air conditioning, plug loads, electrical metering and more. Developed projects will be scaled across hundreds of facilities across the network, producing energy, cost and carbon benefit.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Build and execute technical solutions for energy and carbon reduction from pilot, data collection, through scaled implementation and measurement & verification (M&V) of results. Energy and load optimization via control systems is a technical requirement: energy-conservation/standby modes, variable speed applications, and equipment scheduling.  
Drive continuous monitoring and energy efficiency improvements with Amazon's energy consuming assets. Integrate power metering into our data sets, and develop analytics to identify opportunities, assess trending consumption changes, and measure benefits of conservation efforts.  
Prepare written analysis of feasibility studies and recommendations for various energy monitoring and power flexibility strategies. Own metering data quality programs, check readings for completeness, outliers, and flag actionable improvements, and reconcile against known loads to ensure trusted insight generation.  
Develop metrics, baselines, and roadmaps that translate technical work into quantified outcomes (energy savings, cost savings or utility tariff arbitrage, load forecast, reliability, carbon reduction).  
Define and own technical approach and cross-system architecture for data configuration, standards and mechanisms for scalability and enforcement of key energy savings mechanisms. Decide how to build and prove new approaches managing tradeoffs for necessary business needs, rather than executing a defined scope.  
Manage projects against plans and objectives to ensure commitments are met, delivering against our power and Climate Pledge goals.  
Deep diving (troubleshooting) and unblocking issues that are prohibiting teams from pursuing energy reduction initiatives.  
Work with critical stakeholders on developing mechanisms for design standard integration for launching facilities that incorporate energy optimization procedures from Day 1.  
Analyze and communicate the financial impact of projects and initiatives (payback, return on investment, net present value)  
Serve as a technical reviewer for peers and partner engineers — reviewing control logic, metering architecture, and design-standard changes, and improving them on technical merit  
Quantify and own value add of energy savings mechanisms and how they reduce equipment runtime and increases reliability and lifespan.  
Calculate and report energy, water and carbon savings using International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol methodologies.  
Manage multiple, complex projects simultaneously.  
Produce clear documentation, playbooks, and reporting that make work-streams repeatable.  
  
A day in the life  
You might spend the morning querying newly integrated power-metering data and validating it against the distribution-panel hierarchy — resolving a data-quality gap — then analyzing load profiles and build an energy-savings or peak-shaving model that quantifies the opportunity by equipment class. You then define network rollout suitability and prioritize these opportunities across sites. In the afternoon you develop control logic changes to implement an efficiency opportunity, propose updates to a design standard, or define a measurement method for implemented energy and cost savings to your stakeholders. You balance trade-offs between energy savings, technical complexity, equipment reliability, and cost — bringing well-reasoned recommendations and escalating the most ambiguous decisions for alignment.  
  
About the team  
The Global Energy, Sustainability and Automation (GESA) Energy team is dedicated to delivering energy efficiency, cost savings, and demand flexibility within Amazon's fulfillment network. We partner closely with design, controls, data, procurement, operations, field engineering, and deployment teams — as well as external vendors — to ensure our energy consumption is monitored and optimized. Our focus in the coming years is scaling our energy monitoring and analytics programs, expanding behavioral and retrofit programs, expanding load flexibility for power resilience and cost arbitrage benefit, and enhancing asset reliability and lifespan through efficient operation. If you are energized by large-scale technical challenges and want to make a tangible impact on energy use, this is the team for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
* Expe

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

**Job Summary:**

  

MUFG is seeking an Analyst to join the Portfolio Management Group (PMG) within the Sponsor, Growth & Middle Market (SGMM) Healthcare vertical. This role is primarily supporting the evaluation, underwriting and management of direct loans and other credit exposures to private equity owned non-investment grade borrowers ranging in size from middle market to large corporate.

  

Analysts will also provide support for the Originations (Financial Sponsor coverage), Syndications, Monitoring/Portfolio Management and Sponsor portfolio company Relationship Management functions by assignment within the business unit.

  

The Analyst will be a corporate finance professional, supporting the Sponsor, Growth & Middle Market Healthcare team and related credit analysis efforts for healthcare borrowers. Critical functions include assessing risk factors associated with each credit and determining the appropriate risk ratings based on established policies and guidelines. Responsibilities will include active credit management and portfolio monitoring for potential upgrades, downgrades or general credit deterioration with the goal of maximizing the bank’s net income while minimizing credit costs.

  

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Support the credit analysis and management of Sponsor/Direct Lending opportunities within the Healthcare industry vertical
* Support the preparation of detailed credit analyses and required credit applications in accordance with internal policies and regulatory guidance, including the evaluation of company-specific, industry, and regulatory risks (including healthcare reimbursement and regulatory risks); and company historical operating performance, projected operating performance and capital structure.
* Assist senior underwriters in the due diligence of leveraged buyouts (“LBO”), merger and acquisition (“M&A”), and other financing opportunities.
* Construct detailed financial models (base and downside cases) to project go-forward business performance, credit statistics, and debt repayment capacity of new and existing clients.
* Assist senior underwriters with detailed credit application memo write-ups that include transaction overviews, credit structures, company profiles, industry analyses, risks and mitigants, historical operating performance, projections, enterprise valuation analyses and other regulatory requirements in accordance with internal policies.

* Support credit analysis for structured credit transactions (derivatives transactions, margin lending, receivable securitizations, supply chain finance).
* Understand and maintain knowledge of healthcare sub-sectors represented in portfolio, including technical aspects and regulatory issues.
Participate in client and bank meetings as necessary.  

  

**Policy and Transaction Responsibilities:**

  

* Support the communication with the credit approval division including final hold level strategies to ensure alignment of risk strategy and policy.
* Evaluate and establish appropriate ratings for transactions and correlate appropriate exposure level with regard to exposure on both a transaction and group level.
Ensure compliance with policy and regulatory requirements.

* Knowledge of accounting and corporate finance
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills
* Strong financial modeling skills

* Able to work independently and in teams under pressure, and collaborate with groups across the organization

jobs.title: Information Technology Risk 1LoD Analyst
jobs.description:
**Poste et missions**
---------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Information Technology Risk 1LoD Analyst -** to play a critical role in safeguarding Natixis CIB Americas IT and ensuring compliance with industry regulations.

They will serve as a key interface for the LoD1.1 Group (BCPE group and Natixis CIB at Head Office) and LoD2 (CISO, Operational Risk and Compliance) in relation to IT risk taxonomies and categories for LoD1 (Line of Defense 1).

This role is vital for ensuring the security and compliance of our Natixis CIB Americas IT, managing software assets effectively, and mitigating risks associated with information technology operations.

The successful candidate will possess a deep understanding of IT risk frameworks, software licensing agreements, and industry best practices. You will be responsible for supporting the Group IT Risk Management (ITRM) Framework, tailoring it to meet specific business or geographical needs, and leading initiatives to assess and enhance IT risk controls for Natixis. CIB Americas platform in coordination with the overall IT department.

**Leadership and Strategy:**

* Strengthen the IT risk management strategy in alignment with Head Office (BPCE Group and Natixis CIB), organization’s goals and compliance requirements.
* Support the Software Asset Management (SAM) program, including process optimization, governance frameworks and contributing ot the associated policy managed at LoD2.

**Risk Assessment:**

* Participate and/or conduct regular risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, and audits to identify potential IT risks and recommend appropriate controls and mitigations.
* Oversee and assist the identification, analysis, and prioritization of risks associated with IT systems, software applications, and third-party vendors.

**Procedure and Runbook Development:**

* Establish and maintain IT risk management procedures and any associated runbook in accordance with industry regulations and best practices.
* Ensure software asset management procedures and runbooks are effectively communicated and enforced across the organization.

**Software Asset Management (SAM):**

* Oversee the lifecycle of software assets from acquisition to retirement, ensuring compliance with licensing agreements and optimizing software usage with alignment with Head Office processes.
* Conduct daily health checks and completeness checks for all software assets in the IT Asset Management (ITAM) system.

**Coordination and Collaboration:**

* Coordinate the Annual Recertification processes to ensure ongoing compliance and accuracy of software assets with the IT asset owners.
* Liaise with relevant stakeholders to facilitate IT controls review and reporting, ensuring all controls are met and documented.
* Work closely with internal and external auditors to manage audits including reviewing audit recommendations and timely closure

**ITAM Tool Management:**

* Participate in the tool feature enhancements to improve functionality and ensure it meets organizational needs, especially around SAM area.
* Manage enhancement requests for the tool, working with IT teams to prioritize and implement improvements.

**Monitoring and Reporting:**

* Prepare risk and controls reporting, including controls, Data Risk Strategy (DRS), and operational risk reports for senior management.
* Submit risk acceptances for CIO Office needs, ensuring proper documentation and justification for any exceptions.

**Security and Compliance:**

* Coordinate the implementation and knowledge transfer related to Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for appropriate applications to enhance security measures.
* Oversee ITAM controls operations to ensure adherence to established policies and procedures.

**Training and Awareness:**

* Support implementation of training programs to educate employees on IT risk management practices and software licensing compliance.
* Foster a culture of accountability and awareness around IT risk and asset management within the organization.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Stay current with industry trends, regulations, and emerging technologies related to IT risk management and software asset management.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance risk management processes and software asset utilization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Risk Management or a related field.
* Minimum of five years of relevant professional experience in IT risk management, IT controls, software asset management, IT asset management or a related area.
* Strong understanding of IT risk frameworks, control processes and software licensing practices.

The salary range for this position will be between $150,000 - $190,000. Natixis is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. Actual base salary will vary and will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, education, skills set, applicable licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Base salary is only one component of our total rewards package. Natixis also offers a generous benefits package, and you may be eligible for a discretionary incentive award depending on company and individual performance.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Bureau of Alcohol and Drug Use (BADU) works to close gaps and reduce overall morbidity and mortality related to alcohol and substance use among New Yorkers. BADU develops, implements, and evaluates interventions and prevention strategies through contracting of treatment, recovery and support services; policy analysis and development; epidemiology and surveillance; dissemination of treatment and management guidelines; harm reduction initiatives; public and provider outreach and education; and community involvement and interagency collaboration. The Bureau amplifies the voices of those most impacted and focuses on inequitable structural, social, service, and communication factors that drive disparities. The Office of Research, Surveillance, Policy, and Communications within BADU conducts alcohol- and drug-related surveillance, program evaluation and research, maintains databases, designs research protocols, produces reports, writes scientific articles for peer-reviewed journals, facilitates program and policy development, and develops messaging and other communication materials for provider and public audiences.
  
  
The Qualitative Research Analyst will support the development and implementation of BADU’s qualitative research and evaluation activities, including project design, data collection, analysis, and dissemination of findings.
  
  
DUTIES WILL INCLUDE BUT NOT BE LIMITED TO:
  
Under the supervision of the Senior Qualitative Research Associate, the Qualitative Research Analyst will work collaboratively with program staff and analysts to coordinate qualitative research activities, including conducting literature reviews, designing and implementing study protocols, collecting and analyzing qualitative data, and supporting dissemination activities.
  
1. Draft qualitative research materials (e.g. protocols, interview guides, and surveys) and support IRB applications.
  
2. Conduct research literature reviews and desk research, including organizing citation and reference libraries.
  
3. Collect, clean, manipulate, organize, and analyze qualitative data using Dedoose, REDCap, Excel, and other platforms.
  
4. Support the Senior Qualitative Research Associate in developing training resources for qualitative methods/analysis and building partnerships with other analytic teams in the agency.
  
5. Support the creation and revision of study and data management systems related to qualitative research, including qualitative codebooks and
  
analytic plans.
  
6. Support research administrative tasks including scheduling data collection activities, managing study materials, and gift card tracking and dissemination.
  
7. Assist with the reporting of qualitative research data, including, but not limited to, internal reporting (e.g., study reports, presentations), external reporting (e.g. conferences), and ad-hoc data requests
  
8. Contribute to the development of manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals
  
9. Contribute to the Bureau’s racial justice and health equity activities

* Knowledge of and experience within the fields of substance use/harm reduction
* Knowledge of qualitative research theory and methods
* Experience (at least 1 year) conducting qualitative methods such as in-depth/semi-structured interviews, focus groups, and/or participant observation
* Experience (at least 1 year) analyzing qualitative data in an applied setting
* Familiarity with public health research, including the ability to read, interpret and synthesize public health and other scientific literature
* Able to work independently and as part of a team

* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

* Oral and written Spanish language fluency highly preferred

Our GRC team runs the certification and audit programs that let security-conscious enterprises, regulated industries, and government customers adopt our cloud products with confidence.

As our Cybersecurity GRC Analyst, you'll support the team across governance, risk, compliance, and customer trust work, and you'll own our annual security awareness training campaign. This is a hands-on, learning-focused role: you'll start with well-defined tasks and take on more complex work as you learn our programs.

We are a small team, so you'll get exposure to every part of GRC. In your first year, you'll gather audit evidence for SOC 2 and ISO 27001, answer customer security questionnaires, coordinate policy updates, and support our vendor risk and FedRAMP work. Experienced teammates review your work and are there to help when something is new or complex. You'll also have AI and GRC tooling, including Vanta, to help you work efficiently.

You'll succeed by being organized, responsive, and easy to work with, making it simpler for control owners to provide what audits and customers need.

**What You Will Do**

* Follow up on overdue security training, then lead the annual Security and Compliance Training campaign: work with People Operations and Legal on the curriculum, set up enrollments in the training platform, track completion weekly, and escalate overdue training.
* Handle training exceptions, keep training records ready as audit evidence, and gather feedback to improve next year's campaign.

* Answer customer security questionnaires, starting with simpler requests and taking on more within your first few months. Escalate complex requests to senior teammates.
* Check answers for accuracy, confirm requestors are under NDA before sharing information, and help maintain our answer library and Trust Center content.

**Audit and Compliance Support**

* Learn our FedRAMP program and support the FedRAMP ISSO as needed.
* Gather and organize evidence for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits, confirm it meets each request, and prepare it for review before it goes to auditors.

**Governance and Risk Support**
